name: Qom-Mohammadieh-Parchin Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Mohammadieh-Parchin Gas Pipeline; Mohammadiyeh Qom-Parchin Gas Transmission Line
values.OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames: خط انتقال گاز محمدیه قم – پارچین
values.RouteNotes: Corridor from Mohammadieh (Qom province) to Parchin (eastern Tehran province), ~130 km, 56-inch reinforcement trunkline feeding stable winter gas flow to northern/northeastern provinces. No official GIS route located.

researcher_notes: CONFIRMED as a real, distinct line — not a match to any of the 42 existing Iran gas rows (no Qom/Mohammadieh/Parchin corridor present; distinct from P6026 North-Northeast). Add-threshold met: (a) sponsor NIGC, EPC by Iran Gas Engineering & Development Company (IGEDC), contractor Anhar; (b) endpoints Mohammadieh (Qom province) -> Parchin (eastern Tehran province); (c) concrete step = under construction with EPC awarded, Phase 1 (72 km) completed and low-pressure gas injection Dec 2021 (Dey 1400). Specs high-confidence via 2+ independent sources: length 130 km and 56-inch (in) diameter (SHANA project coverage), NIGC sponsorship (Tehran Times English NIGC list + SHANA), further Persian corroboration (gasresan.ir, naftnews.net). All three cited URLs passed url_verifier. STATUS CAVEAT: hard confirmation is Phase 1 injecting gas since Dec 2021; Phase 2 (~58 km) was targeted for Shahrivar 1401 (Sep 2022) and missed its original deadline. No post-2022 full-line commissioning notice was retrieved, so 'operating' for the whole 130 km is an inference from Phase-1 injection + the ~4 years elapsed with no cancellation evidence; a status re-check is warranted (medium confidence on status specifically). Capacity not disclosed in any source (left blank). Cost figures in Persian coverage were ambiguous/likely garbled (left blank). ProposalYear left blank (project predates 2021 as a 'second phase'; no firm year found). No official route GIS located -> no route.
